intro.background: 教玩具售后常见问题：运输破损（shipping damage）、色差（color difference）、木材开裂（wood cracking）、缺件（missing parts）、安装问题。处理原则：先道歉+要照片+判断责任+给方案。不要一上来就推诿。
intro.desc: 掌握售后和质量问题处理的英语表达。

oneLiner.en: How you handle a complaint defines whether the client comes back — or never does.
oneLiner.cn: 你怎么处理投诉，决定客户会不会再回来。

vocab.ex: We are sorry about the shipping damage.
Natural wood may have color differences.
Small cracking is normal for solid wood.
Please file a claim within 7 days.

mistakes.right: We are sorry about the issue. Could you send us photos so we can resolve it quickly?
mistakes.cn: 错误：推卸责任。先道歉+要照片+给方案。

basic.en: We are sorry about the damage.
Natural wood may have color differences.
Please file a claim within 7 days.

advanced.en: We sincerely apologize for the shipping damage. Could you send us clear photos of the damaged items and packaging? We will arrange replacement parts by express within 48 hours at our cost.
advanced.cn: 我们对运输破损深表歉意。您能发破损和包装的清晰照片吗？我们48小时内免费快递补发。
advanced.from: We are sorry about the damage.

advanced.en: Natural solid wood may show minor color variation and small hairline cracks, which is a natural characteristic, not a defect. If the issue is structural, we will replace the product at no cost.
advanced.cn: 天然实木可能有轻微色差和细发丝纹——这是自然特性，不是缺陷。如果是结构问题，我们免费更换。
advanced.from: Natural wood may have color differences.

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Some furniture arrived with broken corners. We are very unhappy.
lines.cn: 有些家具到了边角破了。我们很不满意。

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: We sincerely apologize for the damage. Could you send us photos of the broken pieces and the outer packaging? We will send replacement panels by express within 48 hours.
lines.cn: 我们对破损深表歉意。您能发破损和外包装照片吗？我们48小时内快递补发面板。

lines.speaker: client
lines.en: Okay, we will send photos tomorrow.

lines.speaker: you
lines.en: Thank you. We will also review our packing process to prevent this from happening again. Your satisfaction is our priority.
lines.cn: 谢谢。我们也会复盘包装流程防止再发生。您的满意是我们的首要目标。

fillBlank.q: We will send ____ parts for free.

scenario.q: A client complains some furniture arrived damaged. How do you respond?
scenario.modelAnswer: We sincerely apologize for the damage. Could you send clear photos of the damaged items and outer packaging? We will send replacement panels by express within 48 hours at our cost. We will also review our packing process to prevent this in the future.
scenario.cn: 我们对破损深表歉意。您能发破损和外包装清晰照片吗？我们48小时内免费快递补发面板。我们也会复盘包装流程防止再发生。

culture.title: 售后是第二次销售
culture.content: 教玩具客户复购率很高——一个幼儿园集团可能每年扩建。售后处理得好，投诉客户反而更忠诚。原则：快响应、给方案、不扯皮。

rounds.ai: Some furniture arrived with broken corners.
We found color differences on the tables.
We want a refund for the broken items.
